verses.1: It seems that in the night of destruction, a city was destroyed. It seemed as if in that same night, a wall also collapsed.
verses.2: He went up into the house, and the branches of the trees fell upon my head. All the branches were covered with ice; every leaf was frozen stiff.
verses.3: At its edges, a cloth was tied around its surfaces. In its openings, there were holes through which water could flow down.
verses.4: And they cried out in pain and despair. Their voices could no longer be heard. The tentacles of Moab’s evil forces covered their souls, causing them great suffering.
verses.5: My heart cries out in despair at its smell. It’s like the cry of a three-legged donkey. For the flesh of the lamb rises with my breath; it rises through that path. The cries of those who are suffering will be heard.
verses.6: For those who are buried under the ground, they will be like cattle that graze in the fields. All those fields will become barren and useless.
verses.7: Therefore, their sins and faults will be carried along with the river of tears.
verses.8: For the cry of despair surrounded the borders of Moab, all the way to Eglaim. It cried out in the wilderness, and also in the fields where cattle were grazing.
verses.9: For from the waters of Dimon, blood flows forth. It’s as if there’s a fire that burns upon Dimon, causing it to overflow and spill onto the land.
